summary: 45-year-old Texas man fell about 15 feet while near the Gem Lake Trail in the evening, off trail in a difficult area about a mile from the trailhead; rangers reached him around 10:30 p.m. with numerous injuries including a serious lower leg injury; ten park staff extricated him from a steep, rocky formation and wheeled him out by litter to the trailhead around 3 a.m.; ambulance to Estes Park Medical Center.
location: Gem Lake Trail, Rocky Mountain National Park
responding_agency: NPS Rocky Mountain National Park rangers
